content.what_it_is: breaker, 17 wavemaker routines, three sponge modes, momentum-source aggregation, mean statistics and wet/dry masks를 전수 읽어 물리 source/sink를 정리한 노트이다(1-50행). Kennedy viscosity and roller, Wei-Kirby regular/irregular/2-D/data/time wavemakers, absorbing-generating boundary, friction/diffusion/LD sponge, zero-default bottom friction, wind/vessel/pressure/breaking sources, wave statistics and mass-corrected flooding are enumerated with source lines.
entities: WAVE_BREAKING dispatcher and Kennedy BREAKING implementation (lines 14-16)
Larsen-Dancy, absorbing-generating, friction and diffusion sponge paths (lines 37-43)
SourceTerms aggregation and Cd default distribution (lines 45-46)

constants.name: Cbrk1
constants.value: breaking onset coefficient; line associates onset with about 0.45

constants.name: Cbrk2
constants.value: breaking continuation coefficient; line associates continuation with about 0.35

params_defined.default: FUNWAVE-TVD full analysis — breaking, wavemaker, sponge, sources, wet/dry

params_defined.name: Cd

equations.expr: D_gen=2A cos(theta)(omega^2-alpha1 g k^4 h^3)/(omega k rI(1-alpha(kh)^2))

io.name: WK_DATA2D NumFreq by NumDir from SWAN nesting

calls: WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION dispatches regular, irregular, spectral, time-series and initial wavemakers (lines 19-30)
CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE coefficient is consumed in sources.F (line 40)
SourceTerms sums friction, dispersion, wavemaker, wind, mixing, breaking, vessel and air-pressure contributions (line 46)
unresolved: default breaking viscosity computes B=ETAt/tmp1-1, while tmp1=Cbrk1*sqrt(g*h) (line 16). At dry depth h=0 or Cbrk1=0 this divides by zero; the dispatcher/dry-cell guard is not stated.

roller expression divides by C (line 16) and internal source D_gen divides by omega*k*rI*(1-alpha(kh)^2), while beta_gen divides by delta^2*L^2 (line 19). Zero/range safeguards for these denominators are absent.
CALCULATE_Cm_Sm equation uses cosine in y, but its explanatory parenthesis says x-Gaussian times y-sine (line 32). The trigonometric component description is internally inconsistent.

friction sponge and conditional source are written -CD*U*|V|*Depth (lines 40,46). For purely x-directed flow V=0 this gives zero x drag despite nonzero U; a speed magnitude or |U| is likely intended, indicating a component copy error.
Manning friction is summarized only as -(g*n^2/H^(1/3)) with no velocity component or speed factor (line 46), so the displayed term is dimensionally incomplete.
the missing input card is called Cd, but code-side assignment and warning use Cd_fixed (line 46). The exact parser key versus internal variable interface is not disambiguated.
Hsig uses sqrt(ETA2mean) (line 49). If ETA2mean is raw mean-square rather than variance about ETAmean, a nonzero mean surface biases Hsig; the accumulation definition is not provided here.
mass correction divides by WetArea (line 50). A state with accumulated Dmass and zero wet area would be singular; no guard or redistribution fallback is stated.
